confidentialite.titre_vue: What I know about you on this server
confidentialite.vide: Nothing at all. There's no data under your name on this server — you haven't done anything yet that I record.
confidentialite.champ_pas_garde_valeur: Your username, the content of your regular messages, your DMs, what you say in voice, your email address, your IP address.
confidentialite.champ_effacer_valeur:
`/privacy delete` removes all of that.
**Except sanctions and reports** — those are records of the server's moderation work, not information about you. A moderator can remove them.
confidentialite.champ_intents_valeur: I don't even have permission to read message text on this server.
confidentialite.effacer_rien: There's nothing to erase: I have no data under your name on this server.
confidentialite.confirm_intro: I'm about to erase **{n}** row: your XP, your level, your currency, your items, your stats, everything. || I'm about to erase **{n}** rows: your XP, your level, your currency, your items, your stats, everything.
confidentialite.confirm_irreversible: **This can't be undone.** You'll start from zero on this server.
confidentialite.confirm_exception: Sanctions and reports stay — they're the server's moderation records.
confidentialite.pas_pour_toi: This button isn't yours. Run `/privacy delete` yourself.
confidentialite.succes_corps: **{n}** row erased. I no longer know anything about you on this server, apart from any sanctions, which belong to moderation. || **{n}** rows erased. I no longer know anything about you on this server, apart from any sanctions, which belong to moderation.
confidentialite.succes_suite: If you keep posting here, I'll start counting your XP again — ask an admin to exclude you from the system with `/xp exclure` if you don't want that.
